status: Candidate choices fixed before this lane inspected any candidate CAMB spectra; not a blind data prediction, since the amplitude and tilted candidate use the published Planck best fit.
interpretation: Extra-assumption 3D Gaussian adiabatic curvature source; no simulator-to-Mpc or simulator-to-curvature identification has been derived.
primordial_convention: Delta_R_squared(k)=k^3 P_R(k)/(2 pi^2), where k is in Mpc^-1 and P_R is in Mpc^3; CAMB receives dimensionless Delta_R_squared.

candidates.purpose: Untilted square-root-age variance measure; cutoffs outside primary CMB window
Published tilt inserted as an assumption; should closely recover standard-source transfer
Fixed infrared-cutoff sensitivity point; no cutoff optimization
Fixed ultraviolet-cutoff sensitivity point; no cutoff optimization

fixed_transfer_assumptions: Spatially flat background and ordinary radiation, baryons, cold dark matter, neutrinos, recombination and reionization
Pure scalar adiabatic initial conditions; no tensor or isocurvature source
Statistical homogeneity, isotropy and Gaussianity of the proposed 3D curvature field
free_physical_inputs: Overall curvature amplitude, calibrated to Planck
Tilt exponent in calibrated variants, calibrated to Planck
Infrared and ultraviolet cutoffs in Mpc^-1, not mapped from observer counts or settling steps
forbidden_inference: Agreement is not an independent prediction of the calibrated amplitude or tilt
These choices do not derive the expansion history, recombination, adiabaticity or Gaussianity from OPH
A 2D screen angular spectrum is not a 3D primordial curvature spectrum
A numerical floor is only for interpolation and is not an added physical component
